featured_reviews.name: Guru Gym Foodie
featured_reviews.review_text: 10 pin Bowling in TimeZone. On Thursdays there is a waiting line of 200 people. Waiting time varies from 2 hours to 5 hours. After 4 pm the rate on Thursdays is just Rs.99. But it is amazing how Irshad and Shahid manage the crowd so well. The others too keep the crowd disciplined. I go regularly, so I must say I am impressed with both of them (er, the others I do not remember their names). They encourage me by lauding my bowling and scores. In fact I scored 168 today based on the demo given by Irshad. Amazing how Sky City Mall has become so popular and so crowded. I thank all the staff for their excellent service.

featured_reviews.review_text:

A special shout-out to Irsad, who provided exceptional service. He was friendly, helpful, and made the experience even better with his professionalism and positive attitude. Staff like him truly make a difference!

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for fun activities and great customer service.

If you want it shorter, more formal, or more enthusiastic, just let me know!🤩💯

featured_reviews.name: Om Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very worst experience with the staff and technician team. There was an issue with the game, and when I asked the staff for help, the first response I got was, “Inform the technician, not me.” Amazing customer service standards.

Even after I personally found the technician and explained the issue properly, he barely looked into it. We politely asked for either a refund or at least some game compensation since we had already spent so many points on that game and clearly know how to use it. But instead of helping, the technician arrogantly replied, “Who told you to play this game?” and “Don’t play this game.”

Seriously? Then why keep the game active if customers are not supposed to play it?

We even purchased a Gold Card worth ₹10,000 from the reception, expecting premium service, but instead got rude behavior and zero accountability. Rather than solving the issue, your staff questioned us for playing the game itself. Absolutely unbelievable.

I have visited many Timezone venues like Oberoi, Inorbit, R-City, Capital Mall, Growel’s, etc., and never experienced such pathetic customer service anywhere else. This branch has completely ruined the experience for me and my nephew.

The Venue Head, Prabhat, seriously needs to look into the behavior and attitude of the staff here. Customers are spending money to enjoy, not to get insulted for using the games available at the venue.

Truly disappointing. Negative rating from my side.

featured_reviews.review_text: Deepti and Vidhi from Timezone, Sky City Mall, Borivali were absolutely fantastic hosts. Both were energetic, engaging, and handled the party with great dedication. Their enthusiasm truly made the experience memorable.

featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointing experience. The staff aggressively pushes you to buy a game card with a minimum recharge of ₹3,100 instead of clearly explaining the available options. The combo packages are poorly designed and misleading they ended up charging us more than the advertised combo prices. To make matters worse, one of the combos included “5 arcade games,” but the card only worked on a limited selection of arcade machines. Many of the games we actually wanted to play either weren’t covered by the combo or weren’t functional at all. Paying a premium only to find several machines out of service made the experience feel like terrible value for money. Definitely not what you’d expect from a place that’s marketed as a premium entertainment destination. Most of the 5 stars reviews are definitely fake!

They understood my issue and offered me different games. We collected lot of tickets which acts like a currency for some of the items. They have a free bowling round on birthdays. They also have lot of offers and we got few extra bonus points for their social media posts.

*Food*: The main course had Pav Bhaji where the bhaji was completely bland and the pav was served dry with no butter at all. The noodles were just plain boiled — no taste, no veggies, no seasoning.

*Ratings:*
Food: 4/10
Starters: 5/10
Dessert: 3/10
Welcome Drink: 4 out of 10

*Verdict*: Do not blindly go for their packages. You’ll regret it. Based on our overall experience, I would not recommend The Game Ranch — neither for bowling nor for food.

I recently visited Timezone at R City Mall, and it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience! The gaming zone at Timezone is vibrant, well-maintained, and packed with a wide variety of games suitable for all age groups.

From arcade classics to modern interactive games, there’s something for everyone. We explored multiple games including racing simulators, basketball shootouts, air hockey, and a few skill-based arcade challenges. The machines were all in great condition, and the staff was helpful whenever needed, which made the overall experience smooth and enjoyable.

However, the highlight of our visit was definitely the bowling game! It was incredibly engaging and well-organized. What made it even more exciting was that we got 20 rounds with 10 balls per person, which gave us plenty of time to enjoy, compete, and improve our game. The setup was excellent, and the scoring system was easy to follow, making it fun even for beginners.

The atmosphere was lively, with great lighting and energetic vibes, making it a perfect place to unwind with friends or family. We genuinely had a great time laughing, competing, and just enjoying the moment.

Overall, it was a fantastic experience, and the bowling game truly made our visit special. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fun outing in Ghatkopar

To make matters worse, a man wearing a sleeveless vest (sando) — clearly allowed by this “sando-only club of Mumbai” — used extremely abusive and vulgar language, including offensive remarks involving mothers. What is most disturbing is that PRs, bouncers, and even one of the owners present at the time witnessed everything and chose to do nothing. They simply stood there and watched.

Let’s be honest — if such language had been used toward your sister or girlfriend, it would never have been tolerated. Stand for the truth.

The environment felt unsafe, unprofessional, and deeply disrespectful, especially for paying guests celebrating a private occasion. My birthday was completely ruined, and I will never recommend this place.

Public note:
Next time, boys and men — please wear sandos (ganjis) 😍
Apparently, this is the only club in Mumbai that proudly entertains men in innerwear 🤣🤣🤣🤣

Despite all this, there was not even a single apology. The PR (J*Y), who was never present to check on guest safety or comfort, suddenly appeared at billing time demanding cash.

PR J*Y and the owner present that night — after witnessing the abuse and repeated complaints, no one took a stand for the truth.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star

Extremely disappointing experience at Game Palacio Bandra. We booked a table for 8 people on a Saturday night by paying an advance amount through their PR, Jay, who assured us that we would get a bowling lane at 10:30 PM and specifically asked us to arrive accordingly. We reached at 10:35 PM—just 5 minutes late—and despite informing him and paying in advance, he told us that our lane had already been given away and that they could no longer assure us anything. This completely ruined our plans.

The worst part was that Jay made promises just to sell us the table and then failed to honor any of his commitments. We were willing to wait and stayed until closing time, but nobody followed up with us regarding bowling or provided any proper resolution.

There was also no prior communication that table service was restricted to bottle purchases only. After spending nearly ₹25,000, we were given a cramped table under the staircase where our heads were literally touching the stairs. Only after repeatedly requesting the manager and PR were we allowed to order beers and cocktails.

To make matters worse, a service charge of nearly ₹3,000 was added to the bill and was not removed despite multiple requests. We were incorrectly told it was mandatory, which is not in line with current government guidelines regarding service charges.

The venue also shut around 1:10 AM despite being told it would remain open until at least 1:30 AM. Overall, terrible customer service, false commitments, poor management, and a complete waste of a Saturday night. There are far better places in Bandra to spend your money. Game Palacio should be your last choice.

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Palacio for a night out with friends and family, and I have mixed feelings about the experience. Let me break it down for you:

Ambiance and Atmosphere (4/5 ⭐):
Palacio has a fantastic ambiance and a buzzing atmosphere. The interior design and decor create a pleasant and inviting environment. It's a great place to relax and enjoy time with loved ones. They have a lot of games available which is a big plus.

Food Quality and Pricing (3/5 ⭐):
While the ambiance was superb, I must admit that the food didn't entirely live up to the expectations, especially considering the prices. The menu offered a decent variety, but some dishes seemed overpriced for the portion sizes and taste. Palacio should definitely up their game in this department to justify the cost.

Service and Staff (3/5 ⭐):
One area where Palacio could use some improvement is in their service. The staff seemed a bit overwhelmed during our visit, and there was a noticeable lack of attentiveness. Better training on how to interact with customers would go a long way in enhancing the overall experience.

Overall Experience (3/5 ⭐):
In conclusion, Palacio is a good place to chill with friends and family due to its vibrant atmosphere and comfortable setting. However, it falls short in terms of food quality and service, which is a shame considering the higher prices. With some adjustments, it has the potential to become an outstanding destination for dining and relaxation.

I hope this review helps both the management and potential customers in making informed decisions about their visit to Palacio.

featured_reviews.name: Dwarkesh Diwan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Infinity Mall in Malad on a Tuesday, and the experience felt like walking into a calm, polished world tucked away from Mumbai’s usual rush. The first thing that struck me was how pleasantly uncrowded the mall was. Unlike weekends where most malls feel like a human maze, this weekday visit felt spacious, relaxed, and perfect for strolling without bumping into bags, elbows, or shopping carts. The floors gleamed like mirrors, reflecting the bright storefronts and giving the whole place a classy, open vibe.

The mall’s layout is clean and well-planned, with popular brands visible right from the central atrium. Stores like Azorte, Trends, Aurelia, Hush Puppies, Pantaloons and many others had bright, inviting displays. The storefronts look lively and modern, and the mall has enough variety to keep both window shoppers and serious shoppers satisfied.

The highlight, and something many malls don’t offer, is the indoor amusement zone with roller coaster rides. Yes, an actual roller coaster inside a mall! It adds a fun twist to the shopping experience, especially for families and kids. Even if you’re not riding, just watching the structure running overhead makes the place feel more like an entertainment hub than just a shopping center.

Food options are also impressive. I stopped by The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf for a warm drink, and the counters looked neat, well-lit, and inviting. The seating area felt relaxed and comfy enough to simply sit and enjoy the mall ambience.

Smart Bazaar inside the mall also deserves a mention. The store was well-stocked and offered some good deals (like Buy 1 Get 1 on water bottles), making it perfect for quick, affordable purchases.

Overall, Infinity Mall, Malad is surprisingly peaceful on weekdays, clean, modern, and full of good food, shopping, and entertainment options. If you want a stress-free mall experience in Mumbai, Tuesday at Infinity Mall is a great choice. Perfect for families, solo visitors, and anyone who enjoys a relaxed day out.
